risk_note: RV2 (admin module, export of personal data): export queue worker for contract CT-24k / 08 BR-ID-42. generate: under the creator's advisory lock, first fail the creator's running tasks whose lease (updated_at heartbeat, default 600 s, admin.export.running_lease_seconds) expired, then count running against admin.export.max_running_per_admin (default 2) and CAS pending→running; at capacity the task stays pending and a 15 s delayed generate is re-sent. Every later write of a run (progress, running→done, running→failed) is a CAS on the row_version taken at claim, so a taken-over run writes nothing. Sources: users through an identity batch projection (masked phone by default, decrypt only for unmasked tasks) and audit_logs through the B1-34a reader with the creator's scope, both read by (created_at|at, id) keyset with the claim instant as the upper bound (Codex r1/r2). CSV with UTF-8 BOM, RFC 4180 escaping and formula-injection guard; row limit (default 50000) fails the task; done sets expires_at = generated + 24 h and sends the delayed expire job in the same transaction; expire deletes the object then CASes done→expired. cancelByCreator port (pending/running → cancelled, one audit per task, actor = creator). Every state change goes through the generated transitionExportTask(). Registered only in the worker entry (ExportWorkerModule.forWorker). No migration, no contract change.
